name: @djgrant/freeagent/opening-balances
description: Reads FreeAgent opening-balance lines and their journal-set ID.

needs_auth.hint: Sign in to your FreeAgent account, then retry.

detect.needs_auth: $contains(url, '/login') or $contains($string(body), 'Log in to your FreeAgent account')

resolve.map: ($html := $string($); $edit := $match($html, /href="(/accounting/journal_sets/([0-9]+)/edit)"/); $rows := $match($html, /<tr class="([^"]*(?:standard_bank_account|journal_entry)[^"]*)" id="([^"]+)">([\s\S]*?)<\/tr>/); $text := function($s) { $trim($replace($replace($replace($s, /<[^>]+>/, ''), />/, '>'), /&/, '&')) }; $htmlMoney := function($s) { ($v := $text($s); $v = '' ? null : $number($replace($v, /,/, ''))) }; { 'edit_url': ('https://' & $account & '.freeagent.com') & $edit.groups[0], 'journal_set_id': $number($edit.groups[1]), 'balances': [$map($rows, function($r) { ($class := $r.groups[0]; $rowId := $r.groups[1]; $cells := $match($r.groups[2], /<td[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/td>/); { 'row_id': $rowId, 'kind': $contains($class, 'standard_bank_account') ? 'bank_account' : 'journal_entry', 'account': $text($cells[1].groups[0]), 'information': $text($cells[2].groups[0]), 'debit': $htmlMoney($cells[3].groups[0]), 'credit': $htmlMoney($cells[4].groups[0]), 'bank_account_id': $contains($class, 'standard_bank_account') ? $number($substringAfter($rowId, 'standard_bank_account_')) : null, 'suspense': $contains($class, 'suspense') }) })] })
